title: Aggregate Entity Mention Solr Document (v2)
description: Schema for aggregate entity mention documents produced by the v2 importers (Impresso Project). It is the base mention contract plus the requirement that every document carries a deterministic identifier derived from its aggregation key (t_s, exact l_s). Expressing the requirement here rather than as an importer convention is deliberate: the base schema must keep accepting the id-less documents indexed before v2, so the two contracts are versioned side by side rather than merged.

id.description: Deterministic aggregate identifier: 'mention-v1-' followed by the SHA-256 of the canonical JSON encoding of [t_s, exact l_s]. The version prefix is bumped only when that encoding changes, so a re-identification of every document is always explicit. Built by impresso_solr.utils.mention_ids.build_aggregate_mention_id().
